rounds.prompt: Leo wanted to save money for a trip. [gap1] He now takes lunch from home every day.

options.text: The restaurant served soup.
He started by reducing small daily expenses.
The trip was cancelled last year.

rounds.explanation: The sentence introduces the saving plan and the next sentence gives an example.

rounds.prompt: The office recycling bins were often confused. [gap1] This simple change made sorting easier.

options.text: The building has four floors.
The manager added a different colour for each material.
The cleaners arrived before seven.

rounds.explanation: The colour system is the change that makes sorting easier.

rounds.prompt: The coach asked the team to review the first half. [gap1] After that, they returned to the pitch with a clearer plan.

options.text: She pointed out two repeated mistakes in their passing.
The supporters arrived by train.
The referee wore a black jacket.

rounds.explanation: The coach's feedback gives a reason for the clearer plan.

rounds.prompt: The new timetable looks convenient at first. [gap1] People who finish late still have no direct train home.

options.text: However, it leaves an important group without a service.
Passengers can buy tickets with cash.
For example, the station has clean waiting rooms.

rounds.explanation: The next sentence explains the group left without a service, so a contrast is required.

rounds.prompt: Nina had never cooked for so many guests. [gap1] Fortunately, her brother arrived early to help.

options.text: Her kitchen has a blue door.
She made a detailed list before shopping.
The guests left before dinner.

rounds.explanation: The list is a sensible preparation step before the brother helps.

rounds.prompt: The company tested the new delivery system in one neighbourhood. [gap1] Only then did it introduce the system across the city.

options.text: Drivers usually start work at six.
The city has a large central station.
This small trial revealed several practical problems.

rounds.explanation: The trial's problems explain why the company tested before expanding.

rounds.prompt: The school introduced a quiet reading period after lunch. [gap1] Teachers say the pupils settle more quickly in afternoon lessons.

options.text: The library has three large windows.
At first, some pupils found the silence unusual.
Many pupils walk home together.

rounds.explanation: The initial difficulty creates a natural contrast with the later positive result.

rounds.prompt: The residents wanted a safer crossing. [gap1] The council then agreed to study the road.

options.text: The road has a bakery on one corner.
Several cars were painted white.
They collected signatures from people who used the street.

rounds.explanation: Collecting signatures is an action that supports the request and leads to the council's response.

rounds.prompt: The proposal sounds attractive, but it would require a much larger budget. [gap1] For that reason, the committee postponed its decision.

options.text: The meeting room had recently been painted.
Several members arrived by bicycle.
No one had yet explained where the extra money would come from.

rounds.explanation: The unresolved funding question justifies postponing the decision.

rounds.prompt: The report describes two possible routes. [gap1] The second is shorter but passes through a busy centre.

options.text: Many cyclists wear helmets.
The former follows the river and is quieter.
The report was delivered on Tuesday morning.

rounds.explanation: The former must refer to the first route before the second route is described.

rounds.prompt: The town asked residents how they travelled to work. [gap1] The results will guide the new transport plan.

options.text: More than half of the replies mentioned the bus service.
Some residents grow tomatoes.
The survey was printed on recycled paper.

rounds.explanation: The result of the survey naturally leads to using it for the transport plan.

rounds.prompt: The neighbourhood trial did not solve every parking problem. [gap1] It did, however, give residents a clearer basis for the next proposal.

options.text: Even so, the collected data showed which streets needed attention first.
The trial signs were made from recycled plastic.
Some residents own more than one car.

rounds.explanation: The data is a limited but useful result, matching the concession in the surrounding text.

rounds.prompt: The community garden opened in May. [gap1] By July, neighbours were sharing vegetables.

options.text: The library closes at six.
The first seeds were planted by local volunteers.
The road was repaired last winter.

rounds.explanation: The first sentence explains how the garden began before describing its later result.

rounds.prompt: The archive moved its rare documents to a cooler room. [gap1] The change should protect the collection for many years.

options.text: The previous room became too warm during the summer.
The documents are written in several languages.
The archive sells postcards online.

rounds.explanation: The high temperature explains the move and the protective purpose.

rounds.prompt: The course promises practical writing practice. Yet its lessons contain mostly lectures. [gap1] This mismatch disappointed many participants.

options.text: Some participants brought notebooks.
They had expected to spend more time producing their own texts.
The classroom was on the second floor.

rounds.explanation: The expectation explains why the difference between promise and lessons caused disappointment.

rounds.prompt: The volunteers sorted the donated clothes. [gap1] They then loaded the boxes into a van.

options.text: Some donors preferred winter coats.
The charity's office is near the river.
After labelling each box, they checked the list again.

rounds.explanation: Labelling and checking the boxes logically come before loading them.

rounds.prompt: The walking group changed its route after heavy rain. [gap1] Even so, everyone enjoyed the shorter path.

options.text: The leader usually carries a red bag.
Several members bought new boots.
The original track had become too slippery to use.

rounds.explanation: The slippery track explains the route change before the concession about enjoyment.

rounds.prompt: Mara missed the early bus. [gap1] She arrived at work twenty minutes late.

options.text: The next bus did not come for half an hour.
Her meeting finished before lunch.
She bought a new bicycle yesterday.

rounds.explanation: The missing sentence gives the reason for the late arrival.

rounds.prompt: The café added a quiet corner for people who work online. [gap1] Customers can now use the tables for longer.

options.text: A bakery opened across the road.
The building is painted yellow.
It also installed extra sockets near the tables.

rounds.explanation: Extra sockets support the purpose of a longer working stay.

rounds.prompt: The theatre offered discounted tickets to students. [gap1] The campaign also encouraged first-time visitors to return.

options.text: The director studied drama abroad.
As a result, several evening shows sold out.
The theatre's seats are upholstered in red.

rounds.explanation: The sales result follows naturally from the discounted tickets.

rounds.prompt: The repair shop promised to finish the bicycle by Friday. [gap1] The customer therefore arranged to collect it on Saturday morning.

options.text: The bicycle had a bright yellow frame.
A shortage of spare parts delayed the work by one day.
The customer often cycles to work.

rounds.explanation: The shortage explains both the delay and the Saturday collection.

rounds.prompt: The museum expected a quiet morning. [gap1] By noon, the queue reached the next street.

options.text: A popular artist announced a free talk there.
The exhibits were cleaned on Monday.
The museum shop sells postcards.

rounds.explanation: The free talk explains the unexpected increase in visitors.

rounds.prompt: The class planted herbs in small pots. [gap1] Everyone remembered to water them on Friday.

options.text: Each group labelled its pot with a name.
The pupils read a history book.
The school bell was repaired.

rounds.explanation: The labelled pots provide the natural step between planting and caring for them.

rounds.prompt: The festival organisers reduced the number of stalls. [gap1] Visitors could move around the square more easily.

options.text: The festival takes place each spring.
They wanted to leave wider paths between them.
Several musicians arrived from abroad.

rounds.explanation: Wider paths explain the reduction and the improved movement.
